questions.question: Why should you avoid riding directly next to another vehicle?

options.text: The driver may want to use your lane to pass.
You may be in the vehicle's blind spot.
You will have access to escape routes.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may be in the vehicle's blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding directly next to another vehicle is dangerous. The driver may not see you in their blind spot. The vehicle may also block your escape route if you need to avoid a hazard.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Small problems on a motorcycle are more dangerous than on a car. Check your motorcycle before every ride to stay safe.

questions.question: When is there less traction available for braking?

options.text: When a motorcycle is straight up and down.
When a motorcycle is on dry pavement.

questions.explanation: When a motorcycle leans in a turn or curve, there is less grip for braking. You can use both brakes while turning, but you must be very careful.

questions.question: What should you look for in a protective motorcycle jacket?
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket that fully covers your arms and fits snugly but lets you move. Leather or sturdy synthetic material with body armor gives the best protection.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Blue signs with white letters show where services are located. These include rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. This sign warns that the road ahead will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What is most important when buying a motorcycle helmet?
questions.explanation: Protection is most important when choosing a helmet. Pick a helmet that fastens securely, fits correctly, and has a DOT label.

questions.question: Before riding, check your throttle. What should it do when released?
questions.explanation: Check your throttle and clutch before riding. The throttle should snap back when you release it. The clutch should feel tight and smooth.

questions.question: How should a motorcycle fit you?

options.text: Your fingertips should barely reach the handlebars when seated.
The seat should be one foot higher than your waist when standing next to it.
Your feet should comfortably touch the ground when seated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your feet should comfortably touch the ground when seated.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you correctly when your feet comfortably touch the ground while you are seated. Make sure the motorcycle fits before you ride.

questions.question: If you must stop quickly, what should you do?

options.text: Use the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the front and rear brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, press both the rear and front brakes with controlled pressure at the same time. Be careful not to lock the brakes.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle stopped on the side of the road with flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Stop on the road behind the emergency vehicle.
Stop and wait for the emergency vehicle to start moving.
Change to a different lane away from the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change to a different lane away from the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle, tow truck, or roadside help vehicle stopped with flashing lights, you must change lanes to give it extra space. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: The effects are less dangerous than using either one alone.
The effects cancel each other out.
The effects can be stronger than using either one alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The effects can be stronger than using either one alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, can make it unsafe to ride. When mixed with alcohol, some medications become even more dangerous.

questions.question: What can happen if a motorcycle rider takes a turn too fast?

options.text: They will have better control of the motorcycle.
The motorcycle will ride more smoothly.
They may accidentally leave the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may accidentally leave the road.
questions.explanation: Taking a turn too fast can cause a rider to lose control. The motorcycle may slide into another lane or go off the road.

questions.question: Is it easy or hard to judge distances when riding at night?

options.text: It is easier to judge distances at night than during the day.
It is about the same as judging distances during the day.
It is harder to judge distances at night than during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is harder to judge distances at night than during the day.
questions.explanation: It is much harder to judge distances in the dark than in daylight. Shadows and light help you see how far away objects are. At night, artificial lights can distort or hide these natural visual cues.

questions.question: A good lane position should:

options.text: Help you see better and help others see you.
Place you where other drivers cannot see you.
Encourage other drivers to share your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help you see better and help others see you.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps you see other vehicles and lets them see you. It keeps you away from wind blasts, blind spots, and road hazards. It also discourages sharing your lane and gives you a way to escape if danger appears.

questions.question: Is it safe to take over-the-counter medication before riding?

options.text: Yes, because over-the-counter medications are always weak.
No, it may affect your riding ability and should be done carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it may affect your riding ability and should be done carefully.
questions.explanation: Many legal prescription and over-the-counter medications have side effects that can make it unsafe to ride a motorcycle. Always ask your doctor how a new medication might affect your ability to drive or ride safely.

questions.question: Where should your feet be while riding?
questions.explanation: Keep your feet on the footrests while riding to help you stay balanced.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding during the day?

options.text: Bright-colored clothing so others can see you.
Any color because other drivers can see you in daylight.
Dark-colored clothing to stand out against the sun.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright-colored clothing so others can see you.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Always wear bright-colored clothing to make yourself visible, even during the day.

questions.question: How often should you check your motorcycle for safety problems?
questions.explanation: Always check your motorcycle for safety problems before you ride. A small problem on a motorcycle is more dangerous than a small problem on a car.

questions.question: What material should riding gloves be made of?
questions.explanation: Riding gloves should be made of leather or a similar strong material to give you the best grip and protection.

questions.question: What material protects you best in a crash?
questions.explanation: Leather or synthetic materials offer the best protection in a crash. Always wear long pants and a jacket while riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles. These vehicles travel slower than 25 mph, such as farm equipment or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: How important is your lane position when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It has little effect on whether other drivers can see you.
It is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
It cannot protect you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: Your position in the lane helps other drivers see you. It also helps you avoid wind blasts from nearby vehicles.

questions.question: What gives you the best chance of surviving a crash?
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets Department of Transportation (DOT) standards gives the best protection to your head and neck. Wearing a good-quality helmet that is properly fastened is the single best way to survive a crash.

questions.question: What is true about a DOT-compliant helmet?

options.text: It allows you to see as far to the sides as you need for safe riding.
It can be a hazard to the rider.

questions.correctAnswerText: It allows you to see as far to the sides as you need for safe riding.
questions.explanation: A DOT-approved helmet does not limit your vision. You can see as far to the sides as you need for safe riding.
